title: Find / repair / merge / build recommendation function
question: Implement the typed decision function that converts a scout result plus constraints into exactly one of FIND, REPAIR, MERGE, COMPOSE or BUILD, with the deciding features and an audit record per call. Question: what feature thresholds separate REPAIR from BUILD, and on the 284-candidate registry does the function reproduce the human classification, or where does it disagree?
mechanism: typed routing decision with a confusion matrix against the human classification

repair_vs_build.rule: After FIND/MERGE/COMPOSE miss: REPAIR if quality>=repair_min_quality AND defect<=repair_max_defect AND coverage>=repair_min_coverage AND repair_cost/build_cost<=repair_cost_ratio_max; otherwise BUILD. Those two numeric gates (defect, cost ratio) are the REPAIR/BUILD separator.

holdout.rule: A function that only reproduces its training rows is reported as overfit when train_agreement - holdout_agreement exceeds the gap threshold.

registry_source.claim: Per-id disagreement vs the Windows-path 08-WORKFLOW-CANDIDATE-REGISTRY.json is NOT claimed. Confusion matrix is vs the catalog histogram reconstruction.
